subject: DPA redlines, UK IDTA addendum & transfer-impact evidence
messages:
From: Sarah Moss <sarah.moss@maple-fin.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Carter <tom.carter@maple-fin.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: DPA redlines + UK IDTA addendum and transfer impact details

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal has asked me to collect the following so we can move to signature: a clean DPA with your proposed redlines, a UK IDTA addendum (or confirmation of UK adequacy approach), and a short transfer-impact summary explaining what controls you rely on for cross-border processing (SCCs, technical measures, KMS, in-country subprocessor restrictions, where logs live, retention for KV cache, etc.).

A couple of specific asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign the new UK IDTA addendum or propose equivalent language?
- We need a current subprocessor list and a notice commitment window (30 days is preferable).
- Please point us to any evidence (SOC2, recent penetration test write-up, KMS attestation) you can share under an NDA or secure link.

If you can send redlines and an estimated timeline to get this signed (DocuSign preferred), that would be great — we are targeting a mid-March go-live.

Thanks,
Sarah Moss
Head of Legal, Maple Financials
Sarah.moss@maple-fin.com

---
Attachment: Maple-issue-list-20270307.pdf (summary of legal asks)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Moss <sarah.moss@maple-fin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPA redlines + UK IDTA addendum and transfer impact details

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely do this. High level plan:

1) Ill attach our proposed redlines to the DPA and a short SCCs vs UK IDTA comparison spreadsheet for your team to review (see attachments).
2) Well provide a transfer-impact one-pager that outlines the controls you called out (SOC2, KMS key separation, KV-cache retention policy, subprocessor constraints, and where logs are stored).
3) If youre comfortable with our proposed language, we can send for e-sign (DocuSign).

Notes / asks from our side:
- We typically propose a 14-day notice for subprocessor additions, but we can see if a 30-day window is workable for your regulated controls team.
- We have a standard UK IDTA addendum; if you prefer, we can redline it to mirror your in-house language.

Attaching: redwood-dpa-proposed-redlines-20270307.pdf, sccs-uk-idta-comparison-20270307.xlsx. Ill loop Rishi and Laura to call out areas they want to negotiate. Can we set a short call on Wed 10th (9:00-10:00am GMT)?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

---
Attachments: redwood-dpa-proposed-redlines-20270307.pdf, sccs-uk-idta-comparison-20270307.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA redlines + UK IDTA addendum and transfer impact details (internal notes)

Team, quick read-through notes on Vanessa's proposed redlines:

- Data transfer approach: keep SCCs as primary mechanism; offer UK IDTA addendum as optional add-on. For Maple (financial), theyll want explicit fallback language if SCCs are deemed insufficient in future — propose language that triggers a remediation plan + rollback window rather than immediate termination.
- Subprocessors: counter-propose 21-day notice + urgent 7-day notification for changes affecting production (e.g., a new cloud infra subprocessor). Avoid open-ended 30-day commitment.
- Escrowed logs / audit evidence: we can provide SOC2 report + short SOC2 bridge letter; for pen tests, provide executive summary + remediation timeline. KMS: confirm customer-specific keys not available for hosted; we use tenant-separated AES keys with customer key-wrapping in KMS.
- eSign: DocuSign is fine; include an internal fallback to AdobeSign if DocuSign shows issues.

Action items: Vanessa to approve the compromise language on transfers & subprocessors. Laura to prepare the transfer-impact one-pager and pick the SOC2 excerpts to share under an NDA. Priyom to coordinate DocuSign envelope and HubSpot HS-12345 paperwork.

Rishi
VP, Legal Ops (acts as internal counsel for sales)

From: Sarah Moss <sarah.moss@maple-fin.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Carter <tom.carter@maple-fin.com>
Date: 2027-03-09T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + UK IDTA addendum and transfer impact details

Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. A couple of comments after our internal review:
- The UK IDTA addendum in your comparison looks close; would prefer to see the addendum redlined directly rather than a separate matrix.
- Subprocessor notice: 30 days is our preference but we can be flexible if you can commit to 7-day urgent notice for production-facing changes and a 21-day standard notice. That compromise should work for our risk committee.
- Escrowed logs: are these logs accessible for audit requests? We need to ensure availability for a third-party audit with reasonable notice.

Please send the DocuSign link for the redline set youre proposing; well route to our procurement and risk teams.

Best,
Sarah

---
Attachment: Maple-legal-comments-20270309.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Moss <sarah.moss@maple-fin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-11T07:18:00-07:00
Subject: DPA redlines shared for signature (DocuSign) + subprocessor notice details

Hi Sarah — per our call, weve prepared the DPA with the negotiated compromise language and added a UK IDTA addendum as a redline (embedded in the DPA file). DocuSign link below for signature: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abcdef123456

Quick answers inline:
- Subprocessor notice: were confirming 21-day standard notice, 7-day urgent notice for production-impacting changes.
- Escrowed logs / audit: logs are retained in a dedicated, encrypted object store in EU region; we can provide access for a third-party audit under a scoped agreement and reasonable notice (weve noted this in clause 6.4 of the redline).
- Evidence: attached is the transfer-impact one-pager and SOC2 summary. The SOC2 report will be shared via an NDA link once procurement completes the mutual NDA.

Attachments: DPA_REDLINE_FOR_SIGNING_20270311.pdf, transfer-impact-onepager-20270311.pdf

Vanessa Ortiz
